utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with that, Dane. Tell me what still needs fixing and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can still help with the outlet by the porch and the loose hinge on the back gate.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can take the hinge, and I’ll keep the porch outlet on my list too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with that. What needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let's start with the electrical outlets, then the leaky sink if time allows.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good call. I’ll check the outlets first, then the sink if there’s time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a few extra screws and some duct tape if the repair drive needs them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Nice, that should help a lot. I’m probably missing a few things, but we can make it work.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring those over, and I’ll check the shed for any spare nails too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. What do you need from the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I need the small stuff first: a spare hinge, some screws, and maybe a tape measure so I don't guess wrong.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll grab those and a tape measure so we can match the fit exactly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time do you need me there?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Around six should work for me.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can be there at six.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, you mean the repair drive? I heard folks are still lining up tools and supplies, so it ought to be a busy day.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, it’s shaping up busy. I’ve got a few spare hand tools if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’ll help a lot. Folks can probably get a few things fixed quicker with your tools on hand.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word now, Opal. I’ll let everyone know the repair drive is happening and point them your way.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll keep pushing it around the block and send people your way.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can help with that. What still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Which part is still broken, exactly?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It’s the back gate latch. The hinge is fine, but the latch still sticks.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Bo — I’ve got the repair drive organized and ready. Tell me what you need fixed first, and I’ll put it on the list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Roof leak first, if that’s on the list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, roof leak is on the list. I’ll put it at the top and get the crew on it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll mention it to Eli and keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. I’d like a clear list of what still needs fixing, then I can keep my part orderly.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll put together the list and keep things orderly on my end.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I meant to bring the screws, but I might have left them on my kitchen table.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No worries, we can use what we have for now.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks for the reminder, I’ll grab them and be there in a minute.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that if you want — I’ve been hearing folks mention the repair drive, and I’m happy to connect people up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh good, I was hoping someone could point people the right way. I’ll mention the repair drive to a few neighbors while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d help a lot, thanks. I’ll keep an ear out too and point anyone your way if they need details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m putting together a quick invite list for the repair drive—want me to add your name too?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, add me in — I can join, even if I’m a little late.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ve got you on the list — come by whenever you can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: How’s the repair drive going? I heard it was a big undertaking.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It’s moving along steadily. I’ve got a clear list and I’m sticking to it one repair at a time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds solid. One repair at a time is the right pace if the list is clear.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after I check the school pickup times. What do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Just a few people who can lend a hand and a couple of tools would help. I’ll send you the list once I’ve got the pickup times sorted.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works. I’ll keep an eye on the pickup times and send over what I can help with once you have the list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure, I can help with that repair drive. What’s the plan for today?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m heading to the repair drive this afternoon, and I’ll keep it simple: we’ll sort the donations, check what needs fixing, and then hand them off together.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds like a solid plan, Vik. I can help sort the donations and check what needs fixing when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a wrench or a drill if that helps with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help, but do you know what I should bring first? I don't want to show up missing the one thing we need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Bring the drill if you have one, plus a few common screwdrivers and some zip ties. If you're unsure, just come by and we'll sort out the rest together.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep an eye on the repair drive location and let you know what I see.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal. I’ll log that and keep coordinating from here.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep an eye on it and let you know if the location changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Just tell me what you can spare, and I’ll make sure it goes to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can spare a little, but I need to know if that will actually help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Cleo. Tell me what needs fixing and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I need a hand with a few broken chairs and the loose step out front.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can handle both. I’ll start with the chairs, then I’ll check that loose step out front.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there was a repair drive happening, but I only caught bits of it. Did Noah say when it starts?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think it starts sometime this week, but I missed the exact day. Sorry, I should have written it down.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: No worries, I can ask around and check the exact day.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on for today. People are starting to gather already.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming. I’ll head over now.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s moving along. I can swing by later if you need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’d appreciate that. I can use a hand later.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll stop by later and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey Leo, I might be a bit mixed up, but I’m pretty sure I said I’d help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just bring a hammer, some nails, and a tape measure.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it, I’ll bring those by. Thanks, Leo.
